scripts.dev: npm run build:ui -w @wabot/web && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --port 8787
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wabot/web && npm run typecheck -w @wabot/bot
scripts.test: npm run test -w @wabot/web && npm run test -w @wabot/bot
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute wabot-control-plane --local --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute wabot-control-plane --local --file=migrations/0002_auth_rate_limits.sql
